title: DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, September 12, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, September 12, 2018 Posted by admin on September 12th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include American Express (AXP) and Home Depot (HD). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -15 points.
Tuesday the Dow was up +113.99 (+0.44%) at 25,971.06.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.06%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Apple (AAPL) +2.53% and Microsoft (MSFT) +1.70%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Intel (INTC) -2.96% and Disney (DIS) -0.98%.
Last week, Verizon Communications (VZ) increased the dividend for the 12th consecutive year. Verizon decided to the hike the quarterly dividend by 1.25 cents to 60.25 cents per share on 4.1 billion outstanding shares. The 2.1% increase pushes the dividend yield up to 4.4% now and increases the annual dividend payout obligation by roughly $200 million.
The 10-year Treasury note yield rises to 2.97 percent, just three basis points below 3 percent. Usually, the S&P 500 takes a leg lower after the 10-year breaks the level. This pattern of stocks falling as the 10-year breaches 3 percent could repeat itself.
Chevron (CVX +0.47%) was upgraded to ‘Buy’ from ‘Hold’ at HSBC with a price target of $139.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down four-tenths of a cent at $2.839 per gallon.
Earnings Reports .
There are no Dow stocks set to report earnings in the near term.
